svg.title: Project visual features to the language model’s input width
svg.desc: Four grouped visual vectors each have 16 components. An MLP maps each to 8 components. Three text vectors also have 8 components.
svg.metadata: {"id":"ma-22-02","locale":"en","kind":"original educational diagram","sources":[{"label":"LLaVA §4.1–4.2, trainable projection and feature alignment","url":"https://arxiv.org/html/2304.08485v2#S4.SS1"}]}
svg.text: Project visual features to the language model’s input width
Toy grouped width=16, d_lm=8 · One row per input position · V = MLP(G)

g.text: A. Visual features: keep four rows
Every visual row also has 8 components
Match the input width expected by the LM
B. Text: retrieve with three IDs
Even with matching widths, learning is needed
to make vision useful to language.
